title: Samsung — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Samsung.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Do What You Cant." Samsung entered the appliance market as a tech company and never stopped thinking like one. They brought InstaView (knock-to-see-inside), Family Hub, and Bespoke customizable panels. Their Bespoke platform lets customers choose panel colors and swap them later — no other brand offers this. Samsung is the #1 selling appliance brand in the US by unit volume.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Tech-forward buyers, younger demographics, anyone who wants the latest features and smart home integration. Great for customers already in the Samsung ecosystem.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Samsung:

• Bespoke lets customers customize panel colors to match their kitchen — and swap later

• SmartThings integration means their phone, TV, and appliances all talk to each other

• Largest capacity French door refrigerators in the market — 30+ cu ft models

• AI-powered laundry detects fabric type and adjusts automatically

• FlexDuo oven divides into two independent zones — cook at different temps simultaneously
